note: Buchanan County Conservation park just NE of Brandon (RV Life tags it Benton/'Brandon' but it is a Buchanan CCB park). Small campground loop on a lawn under trees in the Lime Creek wooded corridor, with a playground and shelter house in the campground. Near the Cedar Valley Trail; Koutny Pond, the county's largest public fishing lake, is a couple of miles away. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15 electric / $10 non-electric, FCFS, season April 15-October 1 (now from the county's own statement, was note-derived). Added vault toilets. Not waterfront stands. Amperage and site count are not posted.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront stands. Imagery shows a single gravel loop on a tree-shaded lawn, with the shelter at its east end. Lime Creek cannot be seen under the continuous canopy of the wooded corridor north and west of the loop. It is a small stream, and no page or photo puts any site on its bank or in view of it, so there is no basis for an upgrade.
HOOKUPS/SITES: the county says only 'Modern and primitive camping' and that it 'recently improved the electrical service'. No amperage and no site count are posted, so nothing was written.
PIN OK (~60 m NE of the loop centre, 42.3309,-91.9781). Phone 319-636-2617 and both websites confirmed.
